text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio, Teio! You know what day it is
today?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What about today? You mean the carrot
bread
sale?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wrooong! That wasn't even close! Here's
a
hint—Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! You're treating me to carrot
bread today!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wrong again! Why the heck would I
treat you?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If it's not that, then I bet you're giving
me a
shoulder massage today!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
In your dreams! Those are just things you
want me
to do!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, just kidding. Happy birthday,
Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Ah?! No, you were right! You finally
got it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Why'd you get mad at me for getting it
right...
